data.keywords: multi-location gym management software, gym franchise management software, per-location revenue dashboard, coach payout software gym, franchise gym software, gym software with franchise reporting

_rationale: Existing copy already nodded to 'multi-location gym software' but stopped at a generic 'revenue dashboard' — this cycle's research shows the real gap competitors (Glofox, FLiiP) miss is the per-coach breakdown, so the title leads with the primary keyword and the description names the per-coach dashboard and automatic payouts explicitly. Feature anchors: per-location & per-coach revenue dashboards [GAP], Razorpay Route payouts [GAP].
